title: Evaluation of Electricity Market Clearing Mechanisms via Reinforcement Learning: Prices, Remuneration and Competitive Dynamics
summary: The Pay-as-Clear (PaC) mechanism currently used in the European electricity market can generate significant submarginal profits for renewable sources when the clearing price is determined by the marginal offers of gas-fired generation units and the cost of natural gas exceeds certain levels. This exposes consumers to high price volatility related to the cost of natural gas. This report analyzes the recently proposed Segmented Pay-as-Clear (SPaC) mechanism as a market alternative, evaluating its system cost-effectiveness through simulations based on Reinforcement Learning (Q-Learning) to…
